title: 1st Convocation Ceremony 2025 | KPGU
content: vocation was not just a ceremony, but a declaration of intent. As the event concluded, the spirit of KPGU was immortalized through action and vision. Sustainability & Growth The Convocation Ceremony concluded with a tree plantation programme at Durlabh Vatika, symbolizing sustainability and growth, followed by the unveiling of a commemorative stone titled  KPGU - First Convocation 2025.  A Vision for Tomorrow KPGU Varnama reaffirms its steadfast commitment to research, innovation, academic excel
